basic_details.job_title: ANGRAU Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: A walk-in interview for the position of Teaching Associate in the Department of Agronomy will be held on 4 December 2026 from 10.00 AM at Agricultural College, Bapatla of Acharya N G Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU). Candidates must register their names before 9.30 AM at the office of Agricultural College, Bapatla. There are 2 posts, purely temporary and on a contractual basis for not more than 11 months, with pay of Rs. 61,000/- + HRA per month for Master's Degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- + HRA per month for Ph.D Degree holders.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The notice does not print a cut-off date for age or any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: About ANGRAU Agricultural College, Bapatla
content_sections.text: Agricultural College, Bapatla is a college of Acharya N G Ranga Agricultural University. The Teaching Associate posts are in the college's Department of Agronomy, and the walk-in notice is signed by the Associate Dean of the college.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice offers 2 posts of Teaching Associate in the Department of Agronomy. The essential qualifications are printed as items a) to f) below, with "or" between a) and b): a) Ph.D. in the relevant subject, or b) Master's degree in relevant subject c) Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average d) Experience for at least 3 years of respective teaching/research experience as evidenced from Fellowship / Associate ship / Training / Other engagements e) Published one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/NAAS rated ≥4.0 Journals f) Candidates having a Post-graduate degree in Basic Sciences with a 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have NET qualification The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The notice does not print a cut-off date for age or any age relaxation. HRA will be given as per the existing State Government rates applicable in various places/locations and is subject to change from time to time as per Government orders. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled-in application All original certificates One set (photocopy) of all certificates Publications Any other relevant documents

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates register their names before 9.30 AM at the office of Agricultural College, Bapatla, with the filled-in application and the documents listed above. The walk-in interview begins at 10.00 AM on 4 December 2026. The decision of the selection committee for the post will be final and binding in all respects. No T.A. & D.A. will be given to candidates appearing for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Terms of the Engagement
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a temporary and contractual basis for a period not exceeding 11 months. Tenure is 11 months from the date of joining, or until the regular post is filled, whichever is earlier; the engagement ends automatically. The incumbent has no claim or right to any regular appointment in the University or any government organization. The incumbent has no claim or right to further continuation of contractual service. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason. The engaged person may leave on their own by giving one-month notice; otherwise one-month salary must be paid before leaving. Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination at their own expense, as per the rules, to ensure physical fitness before appointment.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Concealing facts or canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification at the time of selection, or termination even during the contractual period. The Associate Dean has the right to cancel or postpone the interviews for this position on the said date due to any unavoidable circumstances.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026 from 10.00 AM at Agricultural College, Bapatla.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must register their names before 9.30 AM at the office of Agricultural College, Bapatla.

faq.question: Q3. How many Teaching Associate vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts of Teaching Associate in the Department of Agronomy.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for ANGRAU Teaching Associate (Agronomy)?
faq.answer: The notice lists Ph.D. or Master's degree in the relevant subject, a 4/5-year Bachelor's Degree with first division or equivalent OGPA, at least 3 years of teaching/research experience, one research paper in SCI/NAAS rated ≥4.0 journals, and NET for Basic Sciences PG holders with a 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an ANGRAU Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 61,000/- + HRA per month for Master's Degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- + HRA per month for Ph.D Degree holders.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition, at the existing State Government rates applicable to various places/locations, subject to change as per Government orders.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring a filled-in application, all original certificates, one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and any other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Teaching Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely temporary and contractual for not more than 11 months, ending after 11 months or when the regular post is filled, whichever is earlier, with no claim to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel allowance given for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no T.A. & D.A. will be given to candidates appearing for the interview.
